component.name: EverLive
component.summary: Userspace VFIO HDMI capture, lossless scaling frame generation, and streaming hub

description.p: EverLive is a userspace capture and gaming suite designed for AVerMedia Live Gamer 4K (GC573) and Live Gamer DUO (GC570D).

ul.li: Zero-copy, low-latency HDMI passthrough and direct display
Lossless Scaling 2x Frame Generation (60 to 120 FPS, 30 to 60 FPS)
Native HDR10/HLG passthrough and real-time filmic SDR ACES tonemapping
Virtual camera integration via shared memory for Discord, OBS, and Chrome
Custom EDID and modeline timing generator
